correctness.rationale: Deleting center c leaves a disjoint-edge graph, so its r-independence complex for r>=2 is the full simplex. The link faces obey |I|+#{i:u_i,v_i both selected}<=r-1. Its subcomplex omitting some near u_i has a good cover by cones D_i, every intersection a cone; nerve full simplex, hence contractible. In middle range r=m+1+q, all-near-u faces form Delta(U)*K_q, overlap boundary(Delta U)*K_q, giving link quotient and suspension of a (q-1)-skeleton; yields binom(m-1,q) S^{m+q}. The relative integral boundary is the sign-twisted truncation of exterior contraction by the primitive augmentation epsilon, with unique top kernel wedge^q ker(epsilon); no torsion. Independent complete F2 boundary calculation for m=3, r=2..7 returned ranks 0,0,1 at H3,2 at H4,1 at H5,0 as predicted.
residual_risks: Small mod-two computations do not establish unrestricted integral representation; full theorem depends on the analyzed relative-chain proof.
